BiblicalUsage: The word names traffic, the merchandise of Tyre's markets, and Ezekiel's lament over the city is full of it. The ancients of Gebal caulked her ships, Javan and Tubal traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in her market, and when her wares went forth out of the seas, she filled many people and enriched the kings of the earth with her riches.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Tyre's merchandise shows how trade can become an idol, because a city that sells everything ends up selling men. I hold that wealth which fills the world and empties the soul is no wealth at all, and God sinks the ships that carry it.
